UPG-110 · P0 · Provenance And Identity
Partially Completed

The Sources surface now provides lane-scoped species, life-stage, region, experimental-unit and admission filters, while human SCI context remains distinct from mouse morphology/type/anatomy. The remaining increment is to add the same explicit scope block to every legacy dossier and export I06 adds species, life-stage, region, source experimental units and record granularity to the legacy Research Explorer and active-record dossiers and JSON/CSV exports for all 671 current records (22 exact canonical parent sources). All 13 exact SCI conditions keep native fields and units, including separate mouse/animal and human/participant contexts and neonatal/adult experiments. Context never becomes an individual-cell property. Remaining: other legacy dossiers/exports and all cross-lane scope-path validation.

Current blocker
Remaining Validation · Queue status is "partially completed"; completion remains blocked at the evidence and implementation boundary stated in the queue row.

Existing mouse molecular/morphology/anatomy lanes, mouse/human SCI evidence contracts and `research-source-registry-0.1`; `app/research-record-source-scope.js`; `tests/research-record-source-scope.test.mjs`
